theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpi_pullback_weak_continuity
theorems.statement: ∀ (m N' : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (H : ℕ → Euclid m → Euclid N') (H₀ : Euclid m → Euclid N') (w : Euclid m → ℝ) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') m), (∀ j, LipschitzWith L (H j)) → LipschitzWith L H₀ → TendstoUniformly H H₀ atTop → Integrable w → Continuous ω → HasCompactSupport ω → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ u, w u * ω (H j u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ (H j) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ u, w u * ω (H₀ u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ H₀ u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))))
